steps.title: Welcome to Pulsar
steps.description:
Welcome! This tutorial will show you how to run a web script in your browser on a legacy page.

You will:
1. Press `{SwitchHotkey}` to open Switch Mode and switch to your browser
2. Press `{CommandHotkey}` to open Command Mode and run a web script on the current page

Web scripts let you automate legacy intranet pages that don't support modern extensions.

steps.title: Switch Mode: app switching and launching
steps.description:
Press `{SwitchHotkey}` to open Switch Mode, hover over the browser icon (Chrome or Edge), then release the hotkey to switch to it.

That's all it takes — Pulsar jumps straight to your browser. No alt-tabbing, no searching.
steps.waitHintText: Press {SwitchHotkey}, hover over your browser icon, and release the hotkey.

steps.title: Switched to your browser
steps.description:
Great — you switched to your browser!

Open a legacy web page you want to automate (e.g. an internal dashboard or form).

In the next step you'll run a web script on that page.

steps.title: Command Mode: invoke the web script
steps.description:
Press `{CommandHotkey}` to open Command Mode, hover over "Run Browser Script", then release the hotkey.

Pulsar will run a web script on the current page — that's Command Mode in action: running a plugin on the app you switched to.
steps.waitHintText: Press {CommandHotkey}, hover over "Run Browser Script", and release the hotkey.

steps.title: Web script executed!
steps.description:
Pulsar ran the web script in your browser! You just combined both modes:

1. Switch Mode (`{SwitchHotkey}`) — got you to your browser
2. Command Mode (`{CommandHotkey}`) — ran a script on the page

Check the page: it should have changed (an alert, filled fields, or a console log).

steps.title: You're all set!
steps.description:
You just combined both Pulsar modes:

✔ Switched to your browser with Switch Mode (`{SwitchHotkey}`)
✔ Ran a web script with Command Mode (`{CommandHotkey}`)

That's the core workflow: switch to any app, then act inside it.

Open Settings anytime to customize your slots, or keep using the defaults — Pulsar is ready whenever you are!
